sections.heading: Core Concepts: Solutions to trigonometric equations

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 4x + 3$ in solutions to trigonometric equations, evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 6x + 5 = 0$.
A data set recorded for solutions to trigonometric equations consists of the four values $\{16, 20, 24, 30\}$. What is the arithmetic mean?
questions.answer: The sum is $16 + 20 + 24 + 30 = 90$, and dividing by $4$ gives $22.5$.
